freeze: Constructor fixed before evaluation; no empirical rerun or independent preregistration.
source: u=u_in+u_tail; in-band spectral support±50Hz and TV<=1V; tail spectral-measure TV<=1/1000V. Full-envelope amplitude>=1/2V at phase centers.
target: Full complex envelope including tail, not only its in-band component.
tail_coefficient: H0+1 for full-state error; H0 if separately targeting in-band state only. No tail estimate inferred from the output FFT.
input_error_V: 1/4000 total: noise+quantization1/10000, gain1/20000, timing1/20000, nonconstant baseline1/20000.
gain_requirement: Relative gain error<=1/100000 on voltage magnitude<=5V.
timing_requirement: Time error<=1/5000000000s with clean-voltage derivative<=250000V/s. This is an illustrative sufficient allocation, not calibrated hardware capability.
timing_source_premise: For this timing allocation, full physical tail frequencies have absolute magnitude<=200000Hz; baseline derivative is budgeted separately. The generic leakage theorem does not require this cutoff.
phase_certificate: For d/(1/2)<=1/10, phase<=100/99*d/(1/2). Thus joint error allowance d<=99/10000V.
rounding: Round inherited rational upper bounds upward to denominator10^12 before new exact Fraction calculations.
negative_controls: tail TV1/500 fails sufficient joint budget
input error1/1000 fails sufficient joint budget
H0-only tail coefficient is not a full-state certificate
open: Spectral TV, finite physical bandwidth, gain/skew/noise/baseline and independent review unverified. No promotion, action estimate or change to prior gates.
